verdict.rationale: Capacities' AI privacy docs say AI features are fully opt-in, and that no space data is shared with any third-party AI services unless AI is activated. Leaving AI off therefore keeps data away from external AI providers, but the evidence never addresses model training. missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment from Capacities and its AI providers, a guarantee that covers users who do enable AI features, and independent corroboration.
